_documentation.purpose: 维护注释，采用合法 JSON 字段代替 // 注释。前三节区分硬件数值、执行策略、说明依据；configuration_control 单列会参与身份/格式校验或依赖加载的字段。此 _documentation 块为可选，只供阅读，解析时整体剔除，不进入计算、报告或运行时 reference_id；完整文件仍纳入来源台账校验。

hardware_parameters.parameters: 硬件数值参数：拓扑、MEM/stream 容量与服务、MXM/IW 延迟、共享 VXM 服务和有限权重缓冲。含明确 assumed 的模型代理；数值用途可能为计算、校验、派生规格或库存。weight_buffer_bytes 是待用权重缓冲容量假设，不是缓冲槽数，也不额外并入物理 SRAM 库存。

execution_policy.execution: 执行策略及其依据：约束/控制仿真行为，内部数值如槽数、分块和固定延迟也属于本类；其中 status/source/version/conditions 是说明与依据，详见 execution_fields。

descriptive_metadata.description: 说明与依据：原生 TSP 模型范围与假设的文字摘要，不控制实际执行。 已归档的规格/库存值见 configs/archive/tsp.json，运行时不读取或合并归档。

configuration_control.schema_version: 配置控制：解析器校验版本；旧配置需显式迁移数值与策略字段。
configuration_control.model: 配置控制：模型身份，必须匹配原生 TSP 解析器。
configuration_control.profile_id: 配置控制：参考配置标识，参与 reference_id 命名，不作为计算系数。
configuration_control.memory_tile_capacity: 配置控制：强制校验 includes_both_banks，声明每个 memory_tile_bytes 已包含两个 bank；不是可忽略的文字，不能再乘 bank 数。
configuration_control.supported_formats: 配置控制：支持格式约束，当前必须为 INT8；添加名称不会自动实现新精度。

parameter_fields: value: 硬件数值输入：固定能力、容量、数量、服务率或延迟；包括 status=assumed 的显式代理，不是自动求值的公式。
unit: 单位约束：随 value 一起校验；不能仅改单位标签而不换算数值。
scope: 作用域约束：区分 chip/core/plane 等；随参数校验，不能只改标签来缩放硬件。
status: 说明与依据并附校验：documented/measured/assumed/unknown；描述证据强度，不是开关。null 必须显式为 unknown，不触发隐藏默认值。
source: 说明与依据：原始来源或模型政策，文字不会自动执行或改写 value。
source_version: 说明与依据：参数依据的文档/配置版本，不是本文件 schema_version。
conditions: 说明与依据：数值取法、适用条件及消费边界；改变公式文字不会自动重算 value，应同步更新数值和实现。
verification: 说明与依据：核验范围与限制；项目设计材料核验不等于硅片测量。

execution_fields.scope: 执行约束：允许的局部仿真范围；不能通过改字符串获得整片调度。
execution_fields.resident_boundary: 执行约束：任务的输入/输出驻留边界，解析器校验支持的边界。
execution_fields.schedule: 执行策略：选择解析器支持的调度模型。
execution_fields.default_tile_mkn: 执行策略：默认 M/K/N 分块；不是物理阵列尺寸。支持的 CLI/API 参数可覆盖。
execution_fields.buffer_slots: 执行约束：当前必须为 1，表示一份 resident A/B/C 分配；待用权重缓冲另由 parameters.weight_buffer_bytes 限制。
execution_fields.weight_load_overlap: 执行策略/约束：权重准备是否允许重叠，取值必须属于本架构支持的实现。
execution_fields.fixed_latency_cycles: 执行策略：显式建模的固定周期开销，虽为数值仍属于执行策略；0 表示忽略该项开销，空对象表示没有此类配置项。
execution_fields.rules: 执行规则：资源共享、屏障或映射约束；只支持已实现的值，修改说明文字不能增加新规则。
execution_fields.status: 说明与依据并附校验：执行模型必须标为 assumed，不冒充硬件实测行为。
execution_fields.source: 说明与依据：策略的设计依据；不会执行此字符串或访问其 URL 来决定调度。
execution_fields.version: 说明与依据：策略依据的版本，不是 schema_version。
execution_fields.conditions: 说明与依据：策略的适用条件和局限；用于追溯，不作为可执行表达式。

maintenance_rules: 新增或移动真实字段时同步更新本注释的分类；不要只修改注释来改变模型行为。
硬件参数的 value、unit、scope 与来源元数据一起维护；是否参与当前 GEMM 以该参数的 conditions 和实际消费路径为准。
执行策略仅可使用解析器已有实现；修改策略后检查容量、动作计数和时间报告，不用库存数量直接缩放任务耗时。
说明文字仍可能接受完整性校验或出现在来源报告中；只有 _documentation 是完全独立的阅读注释。
注释只放在根层 _documentation 中；其他未知字段及参数/策略内部的额外字段仍严格拒绝。

superlanes.conditions: 20 programmable SuperLanes; excludes unverified spare inventory.

hemispheres.conditions: Two mirrored hemispheres, each with two MXM planes.

planes_per_hemisphere.conditions: Two independent MXM planes per hemisphere; four per chip.

plane_dim.conditions: Each MXM plane is 320 by 320 MACC; K and N dimensions both 320.

supercell_dim.conditions: One physical Supercell covers 16 K byte positions by 16 output positions; 16 denotes each axis, not a count of Supercells. It has 16 MML, each with four MME.

vxm_alus_per_lane.conditions: 16 ALUs per lane arranged as four groups of four; 20*16*16=5120 ALUs per chip. This is physical inventory, not task-effective throughput.

mem_slices_per_hemisphere.conditions: 44 MEM slices per hemisphere; 88 per chip.

mem_tiles_per_slice.conditions: Each MEM slice spans all 20 SuperLanes and has one local memory tile per SuperLane.

memory_tile_bytes.conditions: Each 16-lane memory tile has 128 KiB=131072 bytes total, including its two banks.

banks_per_memory_tile.conditions: Two banks per tile; read and write can overlap only when addressing different banks.

usable_mem_bytes.conditions: 2 hemispheres*44 slices*20 tiles*128 KiB=220 MiB=230686720 bytes of data MEM. Do not multiply again by bank count; not a full physical SRAM inventory.

sr_coordinates.conditions: SR0..SR44 are 45 positions along one complete SuperLane. They are not a route hop count and are not multiplied by hemispheres.

streams_per_direction.conditions: 32 stream IDs in each direction at an SR coordinate. Each SL carries its 16-byte portion using the same 32 IDs; do not multiply the ID count by 20.

stream_width_bytes.conditions: One stream has a 320-byte full-vector cross section across 20 SuperLanes; each local SL/SR contribution is 16 bytes. Execution is spatially staggered; 320 bytes is not the local per-SL writer width.

clock_ghz.source_version: commit 071573763db09594a85f2371e7abfc7615cfe509; git-blob b77cbdf8eb55ba46c990dd89060c193445cb81b2; Table 1 architecture comparison; lines 33-40
clock_ghz.conditions: TSP LPU 14nm baseline clock is 900 MHz = 0.9 GHz. This is the nominal project reference, not a measured CIM ASIC clock.

mem_read_bpc.source_version: commit 1db5a44ec36b6d3c7359f283fdd7d06908b212f4; git-blob de8ebc2b25c212b9c409cc88adc629b17b2af2c5; II-B Memory model (PDF pages 5-6, printed 149-150), Eq.2; III-B MEM (PDF page 8, printed 152); lines 431-470,699-713
mem_read_bpc.conditions: Native 14nm TSP memory geometry matches the project reference: 88 slices, 20 tiles/slice, 220 MiB total. The 320-byte vector uses staggered per-SL execution. Aggregate TB/s figures in the ISCA example assume 1 GHz and must not be reused unchanged at 900 MHz.

mem_write_bpc.source_version: commit 1db5a44ec36b6d3c7359f283fdd7d06908b212f4; git-blob de8ebc2b25c212b9c409cc88adc629b17b2af2c5; II-B Memory model (PDF pages 5-6, printed 149-150), Eq.2; III-B MEM (PDF page 8, printed 152); lines 431-470,699-713
mem_write_bpc.conditions: Native 14nm TSP memory geometry matches the project reference: 88 slices, 20 tiles/slice, 220 MiB total. The 320-byte vector uses staggered per-SL execution. Aggregate TB/s figures in the ISCA example assume 1 GHz and must not be reused unchanged at 900 MHz.

install_bpc.source_version: commit 700b6e6509b1742878091382df0d0df3e92732e1; git-blob a1c88357c7a14ea54da7d107cd22b6b89ad0cd8e; 6.5-6.6; lines 372-385; model assumption made explicit in configuration 2026-11-16; fixed-service model schema 3, 2026-11-16; schema 8 split LW/IW, 2026-11-18
install_bpc.conditions: Internal weight-buffer-to-array IW service: 10240 B/cycle per hemisphere, independent of allocated MEM and stream bandwidth. Assumed port limit, not measured. LW separately reads the weights into the buffer; IW does not read MEM again.

install_propagation_cycles.source_version: commit 700b6e6509b1742878091382df0d0df3e92732e1; git-blob a1c88357c7a14ea54da7d107cd22b6b89ad0cd8e; 6.5-6.6; lines 372-385; model assumption made explicit in configuration 2026-11-16; fixed-service model schema 3, 2026-11-16; schema 8 split LW/IW, 2026-11-18
install_propagation_cycles.conditions: Assumed fixed IW propagation allowance of 19 cycles per changed weight block, in addition to ceil(payload/install_bpc). IW conservatively waits for the previous row window to drain. Public BERT results can hide installation latency; this model does not claim exact rolling IW timing.

mxm_first_cycles.source_version: commit 700b6e6509b1742878091382df0d0df3e92732e1; git-blob a1c88357c7a14ea54da7d107cd22b6b89ad0cd8e; 6.6-6.7; lines 381-411; model assumption made explicit in configuration 2026-11-16
mxm_first_cycles.conditions: Method: 20 SuperLanes, one local ACC step each; reserve the full chain for tails and omit additional uncalibrated pipeline delays. Explicit analytical assumption, not measured hardware calibration. Fixed configuration value; update it explicitly when changing its hardware basis.

mxm_row_ii.source_version: commit 700b6e6509b1742878091382df0d0df3e92732e1; git-blob a1c88357c7a14ea54da7d107cd22b6b89ad0cd8e; 6.5-6.7; lines 372-411; model assumption made explicit in configuration 2026-11-16
mxm_row_ii.conditions: Method: Resident-weight ideal compute service: one row per cycle. MEM/stream/VXM still constrain the actual task row interval. Explicit analytical assumption, not measured hardware calibration. Fixed configuration value; update it explicitly when changing its hardware basis.

row_io_latency_cycles.source_version: commit 700b6e6509b1742878091382df0d0df3e92732e1; git-blob a1c88357c7a14ea54da7d107cd22b6b89ad0cd8e; 6.6-6.7; lines 381-411; model assumption made explicit in configuration 2026-11-16
row_io_latency_cycles.conditions: Method: Explicitly omit additional fixed MEM/SR route latency. Payload services are still charged; zero is an assumption, not a measured physical latency. Explicit analytical assumption, not measured hardware calibration. Fixed configuration value; update it explicitly when changing its hardware basis.

vxm_base_ops_per_cycle.source_version: vxm-algorithmic-reference-v1; 2026-11-18; original hardware context retained in source and retired parameter evidence
vxm_base_ops_per_cycle.conditions: Shared single-task VXM budget of 320 equivalent basic operations/cycle. With int32_add_cost=1 this preserves the prior 320 INT32 add/cycle service. Hemisphere scope denotes the active task allocation from the central VXM, not a replicated unit per hemisphere. All operation types share this budget; rates are alternatives, not additive. MEM/stream supply is charged separately. Fixed analytical assumption, not hardware calibration or the full 5120-ALU chip peak.

vxm_int32_add_cost.source_version: vxm-algorithmic-reference-v1; 2026-11-18; original hardware context retained in source and retired parameter evidence
vxm_int32_add_cost.conditions: One scalar-element INT32 addition consumes one equivalent operation on the shared single-task VXM service. Together with base=320 this preserves the existing GEMM cross-K add rate. No independent add resource is introduced.

vxm_fp32_basic_op_cost.source_version: vxm-algorithmic-reference-v1; 2026-11-18; original hardware context retained in source and retired parameter evidence
vxm_fp32_basic_op_cost.conditions: One scalar-element FP32 ADD or MUL consumes one equivalent operation on the shared VXM budget. Explicit new arithmetic-cost assumption, not measured parity with INT32. FMA, DIV, conversions, reductions and complete activation operators are not implicitly supported. Current GEMM does not execute FP32 operations.

vxm_fp32_exp_cost.source_version: vxm-algorithmic-reference-v1; 2026-11-18; original hardware context retained in source and retired parameter evidence
vxm_fp32_exp_cost.conditions: FP32 approximation work proxy: k=round(x*log2(e)), r=x-k*ln(2) costs 4; degree-5 Taylor polynomial in Horner form costs 5 MUL + 5 ADD; exponent scaling costs 1, total 15. Round and exponent scaling each count as one equivalent operation. No fused-operation discount. Reference domain is finite x in [-80,0]; no correctly-rounded FP32 or exceptional-value accuracy claim. This analytical service counts work only, does not evaluate exp numerically, and is not native TSP Exp instruction throughput or latency. Shares the VXM budget; memory and dependencies are separate.

vxm_fp32_rsqrt_cost.source_version: vxm-algorithmic-reference-v1; 2026-11-18; original hardware context retained in source and retired parameter evidence
vxm_fp32_rsqrt_cost.conditions: Positive-normal FP32 approximation work proxy: bit seed bits(y)=0x5f3759df-(bits(x)>>1) costs 2 (shift and subtraction; bit reinterpretation costs 0), then two iterations y=(0.5*y)*(3-x*y*y), each 4 MUL + 1 SUB, total 12. No fused-operation discount. No correctly-rounded FP32 or exceptional-value accuracy claim. This analytical service counts work only, does not evaluate rsqrt numerically, and is not native TSP RSqrt instruction throughput or latency. Shares the VXM budget; memory and dependencies are separate.

vxm_add_latency_cycles.source_version: vxm-algorithmic-reference-v1; 2026-11-18; original hardware context retained in source and retired parameter evidence
vxm_add_latency_cycles.conditions: Explicitly omit additional fixed INT32-add pipeline latency. Runtime first-row add time is ceil(actual padded tile N * vxm_int32_add_cost / vxm_base_ops_per_cycle) plus this value. This latency applies only to GEMM INT32 addition, not to FP32 special functions. Payload transport is charged separately. Zero is a model assumption, not measured zero hardware latency.

weight_buffer_bytes.source: Answer Fast (ASAP 2022), III-C; Hot Chips 34 Groq ISA slide 25; project finite-buffer approximation
weight_buffer_bytes.conditions: One pending INT8 weight block per hemisphere: 2 planes * 320 * 320 bytes = 204800 bytes (200 KiB). Buffer existence and overlapping weight preparation are documented; capacity is a modeling assumption, not a published SRAM size. Separate from resident A/B/C MEM allocation and not added to physical SRAM inventory. No extra LW capture-port limit beyond allocated MEM/stream service.

execution.source: Answer Fast III-C (https://arxiv.org/pdf/2206.11062#page=5); Hot Chips 34 ISA; ARCHITECTURE.md#tsp-weight-prefetch
execution.conditions: One resident A/B/C allocation (buffer_slots=1), plus one pending weight block bounded by weight_buffer_bytes. LW uses residual MEM-read and stream-to-MXM service while rows execute; all reads contend. Writes have an independent budget under assumed conflict-free bank placement. Current rows have priority; row demand/II is reserved across fill and drain as well as steady state. IW consumes only internal install service after prior tile drain and LW completion; the pending slot releases at IW end. One-block capacity, fluid bandwidth reservations, no extra LW capture-port bottleneck and drained IW are explicit analytical assumptions, not measured hardware timing.

description: INT8 single-hemisphere analytical reference with shared VXM compute service and explicit FP32 exp/rsqrt algorithmic cost assumptions; full nonlinear operators remain outside GEMM. Independent MEM read/write services assume conflict-free bank placement. Display-only specifications are preserved in configs/archive/tsp.json; the runtime does not load this archive.
